comment: Regenerate the SystemLink API clients from the latest OpenAPI definitions. Breaking SDK changes include renaming `routines.createRoutines` to `createRoutine`, renaming `file-ingestion.listAvailableFilesGet` to `listAvailableFiles`, and changing `asset-management.queryAssetLocationHistory` to accept a single options object with `path.assetId` instead of a positional `assetId` argument. The refresh also adds newly generated repository root/version exports and updates request and response types across the regenerated services.
